units: <cite ref="Ketubot 12a:8">Keth. 12ᵃ</cite> <he>כדי שיהא לבו גָּס בה</he> in order that he may become bold towards her (become intimate).
<cite ref="Ketubot 28a:5">Ib. 28ᵃ</cite> <he>שאין לבו גס בה</he> for he is not intimate enough with her (not having been married to her).
<cite ref="Mishnah Sotah 1:6">Sot. I, 6</cite> <he>לבו גס בהן</he> she is too proud towards them (their appearance may only harden her heart).
<cite ref="Mishnah Gittin 7:4">Gitt. VII, 4</cite> <he>לבה גס בשפחתה</he> she is too proud towards her handmaid (so that her presence has no restraining influence).

<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 4:7">Ab. IV, 7</cite> <he>הגס לבו בהוראה</he> he who gives decisions in haughtiness. [<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 4:7">Ib.</cite> <he>גס רוח</he>, v. <cite ref="C00514"><he>גַּס</he></cite>.] <cite ref="Tosefta Ma'asrot 3:7">Tosef. Maasr. III, 7</cite> <he>לא גס לבי וכ׳</he> I did not venture to say &c.

senses.gloss: (with לב or דעת) to embolden one’s heart; (reflexive) to become bold.
units: <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 6">Ex. R. s. 6</cite> <he>מי ה׳ את לבך</he> who made thee so bold i.e. who has encouraged thee to take such liberties? Y. Maasr. II, beg. 49ᶜ <he>להָגֵס את לבו שיאכל</he> to encourage him to eat. Y. Snh. I, 18ᵃ bot. <he>ה׳ דעתו לדון</he> he dared to judge singly.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 2:19">Num. R. s. 2</cite> <he>הֵגִיסוּ את לבם</he> they became presumptuous; <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 20">Lev. R. s. 20</cite> <he>גיסו לבם</he> (corr. acc.)—

<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 19">Num. R. s. 19</cite> <he>היה מֵגִיס בינו וכ׳</he> (sub. <he>לבו</he>) was arrogant (towards the king) in privacy; <he>ה׳ במעמד וכ׳</he> was arrogant in the presence of his legions; a. fr.
